title: How Worried Should We Be About Monkeypox?

sentences.en: I spoke with my colleague, Apoorva Mondavili, about what we now know about monkeypox.

sentences.en: It's Thursday, June 16th.
sentences.zh: 今天是6月16日，星期四。

sentences.en: Apoorva, a few days ago, you came to us and you said, I think it's time to do an episode on monkeypox, which we take seriously,
sentences.zh: 阿普尔娃，几天前你找到我们说，我认为是时候做一期关于猴痘的节目了，我们对此非常重视，

sentences.en: So why did you say that to us?
sentences.zh: 那么你为什么要对我们这么说呢？

sentences.en: Why is now the right moment to talk about this disease?
sentences.zh: 为什么现在是谈论这种疾病的最佳时机？

sentences.en: There are a few different reasons.
sentences.zh: 有几个不同的原因。

sentences.en: I thought we should probably talk about monkeypox now.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我们现在确实应该谈谈猴痘。

sentences.en: One is that public health agencies, you know, in the United States, the CDC, but also the World Health Organization are very concerned about this virus being seen
sentences.zh: 首先，美国的公共卫生机构，你知道，比如疾控中心（CDC），还有世界卫生组织，都非常担心这种病毒出现在

sentences.en: in all these countries where it normally has never been seen before.
sentences.zh: 所有这些以前从未出现过该病毒的国家。

sentences.en: Health experts say it's the worst outbreak in the Western Hemisphere since 2003.
sentences.zh: 卫生专家称这是自2003年以来西半球最严重的疫情。

sentences.en: It's an unusual situation because we have a high number of cases in many countries.
sentences.zh: 这是一个不同寻常的情况，因为我们在许多国家都有大量的病例。

sentences.en: And the numbers are rising really, really quickly.
sentences.zh: 而且数字正在非常、非常迅速地增长。

sentences.en: So, for example, the World Health Organization first heard about monkeypox cases in the UK on May 13th, almost exactly a month ago.
sentences.zh: 例如，世界卫生组织在5月13日，也就是大约一个月前，首次获悉英国出现猴痘病例。

sentences.en: And just a few weeks later, here we are.
sentences.zh: 仅仅几周后，我们就到了现在的地步。

sentences.en: Out of abundance of caution, the CDC is upgrading guidance for monkeypox, elevating it to a level two.
sentences.zh: 出于谨慎考虑，疾控中心正在升级猴痘的指导方针，将其提升至二级。

sentences.en: With other cases reported in New York, Florida, Colorado, Illinois, and Utah.
sentences.zh: 纽约、佛罗里达、科罗拉多、伊利诺伊和犹他州也报告了其他病例。

sentences.en: Globally, we are at almost 2,000 cases and another 2,000 that are being evaluated.
sentences.zh: 在全球范围内，我们已有近2000例确诊病例，另有2000例正在评估中。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: In the United States, we now have 84 cases in 17 states and the District of Columbia.
sentences.zh: 在美国，我们现在在17个州和哥伦比亚特区共有84例病例。

sentences.en: So those numbers have gone up very faSt.
sentences.zh: 所以这些数字上升得非常快。

sentences.en: And yet, it is actually still early enough to contain if people find out what this virus is, if they are quick to seek help, when they start to see symptoMs.
sentences.zh: 然而，如果人们了解这种病毒是什么，如果他们在开始出现症状时能迅速寻求帮助，现在其实还来得及遏制它。

sentences.en: If we all sort of do our part, we could still contain this virus before it gets out of control.
sentences.zh: 如果我们都能尽自己的一份力量，我们仍然可以在这种病毒失控之前将其遏制住。

sentences.en: Because it's early.
sentences.zh: 因为现在还早。

sentences.en: Because it's early enough.
sentences.zh: 因为时间还很充裕。

sentences.en: Well, let's establish some very basic information about monkeypox.
sentences.zh: 好吧，让我们先确定一些关于猴痘的基本信息。

sentences.en: What exactly is it?
sentences.zh: 它到底是什么？

sentences.en: I have to say, the only thing I really know about it is that, given its name, it obviously seems to have originated with monkeys.
sentences.zh: 我必须说，我唯一真正了解的是，从名字来看，它显然起源于猴子。

sentences.en: Yeah, you know, that's actually not possibly the case.
sentences.zh: 是的，你知道，事实可能并非如此。

sentences.en: It's a bad name in many ways, because it was first identified in monkeys, but we don't actually know what its natural reservoir is.
sentences.zh: 从很多方面来说，这个名字都很糟糕，因为它最初是在猴子身上发现的，但我们实际上并不知道它的天然宿主是什么。

sentences.en: And it's actually most often transmitted by rodents.
sentences.zh: 而且它实际上最常通过啮齿动物传播。

sentences.en: So there is actually quite a big push right now from public health experts to try and rename it.
sentences.zh: 所以目前公共卫生专家确实在极力推动将其更名。

sentences.en: But for the moment, it's called monkeypox.
sentences.zh: 但目前，它被称为猴痘。

sentences.en: And like the name sort of sounds, it is actually very closely related to smallpox, which we have not seen anywhere in the world since 1980.
sentences.zh: 而且正如名字听起来那样，它实际上与天花非常接近，自1980年以来，我们在世界任何地方都没有再见过天花。

sentences.en: It has that sort of blistery rash that you've seen in pictures of smallpox, pus-filled blisters all over the body.
sentences.zh: 它有你在天花图片中看到的那种水疱疹，全身布满脓疱。

sentences.en: But it's much, much milder than that.
sentences.zh: 但它比天花温和得多。

sentences.en: And how did this virus come to be?
sentences.zh: 那么这种病毒是怎么来的呢？

sentences.en: Where did monkeypox originate?
sentences.zh: 猴痘起源于哪里？

sentences.en: So the virus was first identified in monkeys, which is where that name comes from, in lab monkeys in Denmark.
sentences.zh: 这种病毒最初是在丹麦的实验室猴子身上发现的，这就是名字的由来。

sentences.en: But then the first case in people was identified in 1970 in this nine-month-old baby in the
sentences.zh: 但人类的首个病例是在1970年发现的，是一名九个月大的婴儿，

sentences.en: From that point on, they started to see cases in the DRC.
sentences.zh: 从那时起，他们开始在刚果民主共和国看到病例。

sentences.en: And then a few decades later, they also started to see cases in West Africa, in Nigeria in particular.
sentences.zh: 几十年后，他们也开始在西非，特别是尼日利亚看到病例。

sentences.en: And so it was clear that the virus had started to pop up in human populations every once in a while.
sentences.zh: 很明显，这种病毒已经开始偶尔在人类群体中出现。

sentences.en: Most of the time, it seemed like just from animal to person.
sentences.zh: 大多数时候，似乎只是从动物传给人。

sentences.en: So it was seen in only these African countries for quite a long time.
sentences.zh: 所以很长一段时间以来，它只在这些非洲国家被发现。

sentences.en: And then in 2003, there was a shipment of Gambian pouched rats that came to the United States.
sentences.zh: 然后在2003年，一批冈比亚巨鼠被运到了美国。

sentences.en: And then they infected prairie dogs, which a lot of people have as pets.
sentences.zh: 它们感染了草原犬鼠，很多人把这种动物当作宠物。

sentences.en: So there were about 71 people altogether by the end who got monkeypox in the U.S., in Midwestern states, from these prairie dogs.
sentences.zh: 到最后，美国中西部地区大约有71人因这些草原犬鼠感染了猴痘。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Then, you know, after that, we've seen a couple of cases here and there.
sentences.zh: 然后，你知道，在那之后，我们零星地看到了一些病例。

sentences.en: There was one in Texas last year.
sentences.zh: 去年德克萨斯州有一例。

sentences.en: There were a couple in the U.K.
sentences.zh: 2018年在英国有几例。
但几乎总是发生在有非洲旅行史的人身上。

sentences.en: But pretty much always in people with some sort of history of travel to Africa.
sentences.zh: 这一次，我们看到很多从未去过非洲、完全没有旅行史的人感染了。

sentences.en: This time, we're seeing it in a lot of people who have never been to Africa and who have no travel history at all.
sentences.zh: 而且它已经出现在很多国家，目前有30多个国家，我们以前从未在这些地方见过猴痘。

sentences.en: And it's been in a lot of countries, 30-some countries at this point, where we've never seen monkeypox before.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Hmm.

sentences.zh: 你知道，如果没有明显的感染地点，这通常是一个迹象，表明它可能已经在社区中传播了，这就是为什么他们

sentences.en: You know, if there's no obvious place that they caught their infection, that's always a sign that it might already be spreading in the community, and that's why they don't

sentences.zh: 这很有趣，因为美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）确实批准了一种用于天花和猴痘的疫苗。

sentences.en: But ring vaccination with what vaccine?
sentences.zh: 美国实际上在天花疫苗上投入了不少资金，因为我们一直担心它作为一种潜在的生物恐怖主义威胁。

sentences.en: So this is interesting because the FDA did approve a vaccine for smallpox and monkeypox.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以我们储备了大量的疫苗和药物，以防那种攻击。

sentences.en: has actually invested quite a bit in vaccines for smallpox because we've been worried about it as a potential bioterrorism threat.
sentences.zh: 所以你是说，一种用于对抗天花的生物战疫苗储备，在这次新的猴痘疫情中突然变得非常有用了？

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 是的，因为它们实际上是非常接近的病毒。

sentences.en: So we have a whole bunch of vaccine and a whole bunch of drug just in case of that kind of attack.
sentences.zh: 所以我们在美国的紧急储备中有大约1亿剂更现代版本的疫苗，这种疫苗曾被用于根除天花。

sentences.en: So you're saying that a bio-warfare stockpile of vaccine against smallpox is suddenly very useful in this new outbreak of monkeypox?
sentences.zh: 然后我们还有另一种名为Jynneos的疫苗，它是专门为天花和猴痘开发的，并于2019年获得批准。

sentences.en: Yes, because they're actually very closely related viruses.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So we have in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 你所描述的是如何限制与猴痘患者有密切接触的人群之间的传播。

sentences.en: emergency stockpile about 100 million doses of a more modern version of the vaccine that was used to eradicate smallpox.
sentences.zh: 那么对于更广泛的人群呢？

sentences.en: And then we have this other vaccine called Ginias that was developed specifically for smallpox and monkeypox and approved in 2019.
sentences.zh: 或者说对更广泛人群的担忧还不存在？

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，这种病毒确实有可能从那个群体中传播出来，对吧？

sentences.en: What you're describing is how the spread is limited among people who have close contact with somebody who has monkeypox.
sentences.zh: （注：此处原文编号缺失，根据上下文补全）

sentences.en: What about for the larger population?
sentences.zh: （注：此处原文编号缺失，根据上下文补全）

sentences.en: Or is there not a concern yet about that larger population?
sentences.zh: （注：此处原文编号缺失，根据上下文补全）

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, there is a chance that this virus could get out of that population, right?
sentences.zh: （注：此处原文编号缺失，根据上下文补全）

sentences.en: Especially the longer it goes on, because a lot of those men live with other people.
sentences.zh: 尤其是随着时间推移，因为很多这类男性是与他人共同生活的。

sentences.en: They live with women.
sentences.zh: 他们与女性同住。

sentences.en: They live with kids.
sentences.zh: 他们与孩子同住。

sentences.en: They live with older people.
sentences.zh: 他们与老人同住。

sentences.en: And we know that the virus spreads to close contact.
sentences.zh: 我们知道这种病毒通过密切接触传播。

sentences.en: But in a very small number of cases, it looks like it could also be airborne.
sentences.zh: 但在极少数情况下，它看起来也可能是通过空气传播的。

sentences.en: So if, you know, somebody's sharing the same airspace for a significant period of time, they could get infected.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果有人在同一密闭空间内待了相当长的时间，他们就有可能被感染。

sentences.en: And so those are cases that we're not necessarily accounting for when we just talk about sexual contact or close physical contact.
sentences.zh: 因此，当我们只谈论性接触或密切身体接触时，并不一定考虑到了这些病例。

sentences.en: And how significant a threat is the airborne spread of monkeypox?
sentences.zh: 猴痘的空气传播威胁有多大？

sentences.en: I want to be very clear and say that, you know, airborne is not the kind of airborne that we talked about when we were talking about the coronavirus or measles.
sentences.zh: 我想明确一点，这种“空气传播”并不是我们谈论新冠病毒或麻疹时所说的那种空气传播。

sentences.en: This virus does not seem to travel long distances or stay in there for really long periods of time.
sentences.zh: 这种病毒似乎不会长距离传播，也不会在空气中长时间停留。

sentences.en: It is not the major route of transmission.
sentences.zh: 它不是主要的传播途径。

sentences.en: But the experts that I've been talking to are saying that it is capable of being inhaled
sentences.zh: 但我交谈过的专家表示，它确实可以通过吸入传播，

sentences.en: if, you know, you're at somewhat close range of a patient and you're sharing the same airspace for some significant amount of time.
sentences.zh: 前提是你与患者距离较近，并且在同一密闭空间内待了相当长的时间。

sentences.en: So that means a household contact, for example, who is in the same room for some period of time with the patient.
sentences.zh: 这意味着，例如与患者同处一室一段时间的家庭接触者。

sentences.en: And the CDC has said that health care workers who are interacting with patients should wear masks.
sentences.zh: 美国疾控中心（CDC）已表示，与患者接触的医护人员应佩戴口罩。

sentences.en: So people at short range contact with the patients.
sentences.zh: 也就是与患者近距离接触的人。

sentences.en: So you keep describing the greatest risk as someone being very close to someone with monkeypox.
sentences.zh: 所以你一直强调最大的风险是与猴痘患者近距离接触。

sentences.en: I'm not hearing you say that your average person walking around the world has all that much to fear in terms of getting monkeypox.
sentences.zh: 我没听你说普通人在日常生活中有多大必要担心感染猴痘。

sentences.en: Is that right?
sentences.zh: 是这样吗？

sentences.en: I think that's fair.
sentences.zh: 我认为这种说法是合理的。

sentences.en: I think the average person does not have that much to fear.
sentences.zh: 我认为普通人不必过于担心。

sentences.en: What experts are more concerned about is patients who don't quite know that they're infected because maybe their symptoms are mild are then transmitting it to other people.
sentences.zh: 专家们更担心的是那些因为症状轻微而不知道自己已感染的患者，他们会把病毒传染给其他人。

sentences.en: And then it sort of fans out from there so that, you know, we still do see it spread to several hundred or several thousand cases in this country.
sentences.zh: 然后病毒就会扩散开来，导致我们在国内看到数百甚至数千例病例。

sentences.en: But, you know, if we do all the right things, we are going to contain this outbreak.
sentences.zh: 但如果我们采取正确的措施，我们就能控制住这次疫情。

sentences.en: So it's just that we're going to see the numbers get a lot worse before they get better.
sentences.zh: 只是在好转之前，数据可能会变得更糟。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后回来。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·朗森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重塑者》，这是一档关于设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you
sentences.zh: 即使是在我那个黑胶唱片时代的夜店当DJ的时候，每天晚上你都要带着300件最珍贵的宝贝去上班，

sentences.en: and you turned a DJ booth into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 然后把DJ台变成一个充满活力的快闪博物馆，陈列着这些美丽的、有50年历史的艺术品。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼（Audemars Piguet）出品的《重塑者》。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《Dealbook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市的Dealbook峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的人物，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zoran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、佐兰·蒙达尼等等。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些坦率、未经剪辑的现场对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将于11月18日在nytimes.com上直播精选采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得一个月的免费阅读权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: So let's talk about treatment for just a moment.
sentences.zh: 我们来谈谈治疗方法。

sentences.en: You mentioned ring vaccination as a way of preventing people from potentially getting the virus if they're in close contact with someone who has it.
sentences.zh: 你提到了环形疫苗接种，作为一种预防与患者密切接触者感染病毒的方法。

sentences.en: But let's say in the coming weeks, dozens, if not hundreds of people in a place like the U.S.
sentences.zh: 但假设在接下来的几周里，美国有几十甚至几百人

sentences.en: suddenly get monkeypox.
sentences.zh: 突然感染了猴痘。

sentences.en: Ring vaccination didn't stop it.
sentences.zh: 环形疫苗接种没能阻止它。

sentences.en: What kind of treatment options are there?
sentences.zh: 那有什么治疗方案呢？

sentences.en: So there are a couple of drugs available, and when you look into them closer, it's really just one because the second one is very toxic.
sentences.zh: 目前有几种药物可用，但仔细研究后发现，其实只有一种，因为第二种毒性很大。

sentences.en: But there is a drug called TPOX that has been shown to be somewhat effective in reducing the sort of length of illness and the severity.
sentences.zh: 有一种叫TPOX的药物，已被证明在缩短病程和减轻严重程度方面有一定疗效。

sentences.en: And we do have quite a lot of doses of that in the United States, and we could get many more if we wanted them.
sentences.zh: 我们在美国有相当多的储备，如果需要，我们还可以获得更多。

sentences.en: But again, so far in this outbreak, we haven't really seen the kind of very severe cases that would need that kind of intervention.
sentences.zh: 但同样，到目前为止，在这次疫情中，我们还没有看到需要那种干预措施的重症病例。

sentences.en: Historically, the kind of monkeypox cases that we've seen would need to be hospitalized.
sentences.zh: 从历史上看，我们所见的猴痘病例通常需要住院治疗。

sentences.en: But in this case, most people are actually recovering at home.
sentences.zh: 但在这次疫情中，大多数人实际上是在家康复的。

sentences.en: So this may self-resolve in many cases.
sentences.zh: 所以很多情况下这可能会自愈。

sentences.en: This may self-resolve in many cases.
sentences.zh: 很多情况下这可能会自愈。

sentences.en: Really, the thing we're worried about more is how many people the patient will spread it to before they get better.
sentences.zh: 我们真正担心的是患者在康复前会传染给多少人。

sentences.en: So has the government issued any guidance on quarantining or containment the way we have with COVID for people who get monkeypox,
sentences.zh: 那么政府是否针对猴痘患者发布了像新冠那样的隔离或防控指南，

sentences.en: or is it just not widespread enough for the government to have done that?
sentences.zh: 还是说因为传播范围不够广，政府还没这样做？

sentences.en: They are asking patients to isolate at home so that they don't have much chance to spread it to anybody else.
sentences.zh: 他们要求患者居家隔离，这样他们就没有太多机会传染给别人。

sentences.en: And then they are also asking people to stay away from their pets, if possible, and, you know,
sentences.zh: 他们还要求人们尽可能远离宠物，并且，

sentences.en: to avoid wild animals because we don't really want to take the chance that the virus would jump into those animals.
sentences.zh: 要避免接触野生动物，因为我们真的不想冒病毒跳跃到这些动物身上的风险。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And then potentially jump out of them back to humans in a different form.
sentences.zh: 然后可能以不同的形式跳回到人类身上。

sentences.en: Potentially.
sentences.zh: 有可能。

sentences.en: But also, we don't want it to find a new home in those animals because then it would just stick around forever.
sentences.zh: 而且我们也不希望它在这些动物身上找到新的宿主，否则它就会永远存在下去。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: Aprova, to the degree that so far in the U.S., and it seems like in many different countries, this outbreak has been concentrated among gay men,
sentences.zh: 阿普尔娃，考虑到目前在美国，以及似乎在许多其他国家，这次疫情都集中在男同性恋群体中，

sentences.en: how are public health agencies in those countries, especially in the U.S., thinking about communication to those communities?
sentences.zh: 这些国家的公共卫生机构，特别是美国，是如何考虑与这些群体进行沟通的？

sentences.en: It's been really tricky.
sentences.zh: 这真的很棘手。

sentences.en: I think it's been a very, very tricky balance for them to strike because they want to alert that community.
sentences.zh: 我认为这对他们来说是一个非常、非常微妙的平衡，因为他们既想提醒那个群体，

sentences.en: They want all these men to be aware.
sentences.zh: 他们希望所有这些男性都能意识到风险。

sentences.en: But at the same time, they don't want to give the message that this is a virus that only affects gay men because that's not true either.
sentences.zh: 但同时，他们也不想传达出“这是一种只影响男同性恋的病毒”的信息，因为那也不是事实。

sentences.en: And they also don't want to stigmatize that population.
sentences.zh: 而且他们也不想污名化那个群体。

sentences.en: You know, that's a big mistake we made at the beginning of the AIDS epidemic where we made assumptions about the virus, but we also really stigmatized men who have sex with men.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这是我们在艾滋病流行初期犯的一个大错，当时我们对病毒做了假设，但也确实严重污名化了男男性行为者。

sentences.en: And public health authorities are trying very hard this time to arm men with information and yet not stigmatize them
sentences.zh: 公共卫生部门这次正努力向男性提供信息，同时又不污名化他们，

sentences.en: and not spread the myth that this is not going to go beyond that population.
sentences.zh: 也不传播“这种病毒不会超出该群体”的谬论。

sentences.en: So what does that look like, that balancing act so far?
sentences.zh: 那么到目前为止，这种平衡是如何体现的？

sentences.en: This is Pride Month.
sentences.zh: 现在是“骄傲月”。

sentences.en: It's June, right?
sentences.zh: 是六月，对吧？

sentences.en: There are lots and lots of gay pride events all over the world.
sentences.zh: 世界各地都有很多很多的同性恋骄傲活动。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: There are lots of parties, lots of celebration, lots of people close together, close contact, lots of opportunities for the virus to spread.
sentences.zh: 有很多派对，很多庆祝活动，很多人聚集在一起，密切接触，这为病毒传播提供了很多机会。

sentences.en: And so public health experts are trying to work with the organizers of some of those events and try to get the message out.
sentences.zh: 因此，公共卫生专家正试图与其中一些活动的组织者合作，努力传达信息。

sentences.en: You know, Grindr has had a couple of public service announcements.
sentences.zh: 你知道，Grindr已经发布了几条公共服务公告。

sentences.en: This is a gay dating site.
sentences.zh: 这是一个同性恋交友网站。

sentences.en: This is a gay dating site, correct.
sentences.zh: 这是一个同性恋交友网站，没错。

sentences.en: And, you know, they are really trying to do outreach through community groups so that as many men in that community as possible really understand the risks.
sentences.zh: 他们确实在努力通过社区团体进行外展工作，以便该社区尽可能多的男性真正了解风险。

sentences.en: But again, at the same time, we want to make sure that nobody is under the impression that this is just a gay man's disease because that's not true.
sentences.zh: 但同样，我们要确保没有人认为这只是男同性恋的疾病，因为那不是事实。

sentences.en: We want everyone to know what this virus is and what this disease looks like.
sentences.zh: 我们希望每个人都知道这种病毒是什么，以及这种疾病是什么样子的。

sentences.en: So finally, Apoorva, the weird thing about talking about a new public health threat at this moment we're in is that we're already dealing with a huge public health threat,
sentences.zh: 最后，阿普尔娃，在当下这个时刻谈论一种新的公共卫生威胁，奇怪之处在于我们已经在应对一个巨大的公共卫生威胁，

sentences.en: which is COVID-19.
sentences.zh: 那就是新冠肺炎（COVID-19）。

sentences.en: And so it's very tempting to draw a lot of parallels between the two to wonder if we're overreacting or underreacting, which are questions we're still asking about COVID.
sentences.zh: 所以人们很容易在两者之间画上很多等号，想知道我们是否反应过度或反应不足，这些问题我们至今仍在问新冠。

sentences.en: But for a lot of reasons that you've laid out, these are not the same kind of public health threat, COVID and monkeypox.
sentences.zh: 但正如你所列举的许多原因，新冠和猴痘并不是同一种公共卫生威胁。

sentences.en: So how do you think about the two of them in your head at this moment?
sentences.zh: 那么你现在是如何看待这两者的？

sentences.en: Or are you trying to keep them as far apart as possible?
sentences.zh: 还是说你尽量把它们区分开来？

sentences.en: I mean, comparisons are inevitable because I am still writing about COVID and now I'm writing about monkeypox.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，比较是不可避免的，因为我还在写关于新冠的文章，现在又在写猴痘。

sentences.en: And, you know, for a lot of people, I think the coronavirus was the first virus they paid close attention to.
sentences.zh: 而且，对于很多人来说，我认为新冠病毒是他们第一次密切关注的病毒。

sentences.en: It's the reference point for a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 它是很多人的参考点。

sentences.en: So, you know, for example, when we talk about monkeypox being airborne, it's natural to immediately say, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以，例如，当我们谈论猴痘通过空气传播时，人们很自然地会立刻说，

sentences.en: it's airborne in ways that the coronavirus is and is not airborne in the ways that coronavirus is.
sentences.zh: 它在某些方面像新冠一样通过空气传播，而在某些方面又不像新冠那样传播。

sentences.en: So it's an inevitable place to go when we're talking about this virus.
sentences.zh: 所以当我们谈论这种病毒时，这是一个不可避免的话题。

sentences.en: I do worry, though, that because we're coming off of COVID and we're coming off of these horrific two and a half years that we've had,
sentences.zh: 但我确实担心，因为我们刚经历过新冠，刚经历过这可怕的两年半，

sentences.en: that people just don't want to hear about another virus.
sentences.zh: 人们根本不想再听到另一种病毒的消息。

sentences.en: So even though...
sentences.zh: 所以即使……

sentences.en: Right, there's fatigue.
sentences.zh: 没错，有疲劳感。

sentences.en: There's so much fatigue.
sentences.zh: 有太多的疲劳感了。

sentences.en: But, you know, we don't want to be so fatigued that we don't pay attention to a virus that actually is important.
sentences.zh: 但是，我们不能因为疲劳而忽视一种确实很重要的病毒。

sentences.en: We did that with COVID.
sentences.zh: 我们在新冠上就犯过这种错。

sentences.en: We know what happens when we bury our head in the sand and pretend that the problem is somewhere else in some other people and is never going to affect us.
sentences.zh: 我们知道当我们掩耳盗铃，假装问题发生在别处、发生在别人身上，永远不会影响我们时会发生什么。

sentences.en: You know, in public health, there's this idea of a precautionary principle, which means you don't wait until you have all the information before you act.
sentences.zh: 在公共卫生领域，有一个“预防原则”的概念，意思是不要等到掌握了所有信息才采取行动。

sentences.en: You sort of look at what information you do have and you take the most precautions you can to prevent that.
sentences.zh: 你要审视现有的信息，并采取尽可能多的预防措施来防止它。

sentences.en: Right, because the precautionary principles lesson with COVID was because we waited so long to get as much information as we could,
sentences.zh: 没错，因为新冠带来的预防原则教训是，由于我们等待了太久才尽可能多地获取信息，

sentences.en: we missed the window of time to really prevent that virus from ravaging our country.
sentences.zh: 我们错过了防止病毒蹂躏我们国家的窗口期。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: With that virus, we repeatedly didn't take it seriously enough until things went out of control.
sentences.zh: 对于那种病毒，我们反复地没有给予足够的重视，直到局势失控。

sentences.en: And we don't want to repeat that with this virus.
sentences.zh: 我们不想在这种病毒上重蹈覆辙。

sentences.en: Well, Apoorva, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，阿普尔娃，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们很感激。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后回来。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·朗森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重塑者》，这是一档关于设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you.
sentences.zh: 即使是在我那个黑胶唱片时代的夜店当DJ的时候，每天晚上你都要带着300件最珍贵的宝贝去上班。

sentences.en: And you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 然后把DJ台变成一个充满活力的快闪博物馆，陈列着这些美丽的、有50年历史的艺术品。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼出品的《重塑者》。

sentences.en: Subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today, and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 订阅《纽约时报》，立即下载《时报》应用程序，即可获得30天的免费阅读权限。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, in its most forceful attempt so far to lower inflation, the Federal Reserve raised interest rates by three-quarters of a percentage point,
sentences.zh: 周三，美联储为了降低通胀，采取了迄今为止最强有力的举措，将利率提高了0.75个百分点，

sentences.en: its biggest increase since 1994.
sentences.zh: 这是自1994年以来的最大增幅。

sentences.en: The Fed hopes that making the cost of borrowing higher will pull money out of the economy, dampen consumer demand, and eventually lower prices.
sentences.zh: 美联储希望提高借贷成本能从经济中抽走资金，抑制消费需求，并最终降低价格。

sentences.en: But the higher interest rate also risks tipping the economy into a recession.
sentences.zh: 但更高的利率也存在使经济陷入衰退的风险。

sentences.en: And a major new report has found that the number of abortions in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 一份新的重要报告发现，美国的堕胎数量

sentences.en: is on the rise, reversing a three-decade decline.
sentences.zh: 正在上升，扭转了三十年来的下降趋势。

sentences.en: In 2017, the report found 18.4% of pregnancies ended in abortion.
sentences.zh: 报告发现，2017年有18.4%的怀孕以堕胎告终。

sentences.en: In 2020, that number rose to 20.6%.
sentences.zh: 到2020年，这一数字上升到了20.6%。

sentences.en: The increase came as many Republican-led states made it harder to get an abortion, and as conservatives have gotten ever closer to overturning Roe v.
sentences.zh: 这一增长发生之际，许多共和党领导的州加大了堕胎难度，保守派也越来越接近推翻“罗诉韦德案”。

sentences.en: Wade.
sentences.zh: （韦德案）

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Nina Feldman and Michael Simon-Johnson, with help from Rob Zipko.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由尼娜·费尔德曼和迈克尔·西蒙-约翰逊制作，罗布·齐普科提供了帮助。

sentences.zh: 节目由M.J.

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Landsberg of Wonderland.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由Wonderland的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰兹伯格创作。
